university: Tunku Abdul Rahman University of Management and Technology
program_name: Bachelor of Arts (Honours) English with Education

requirements.general_text: (1) STPM - Grade C in 2 relevant subjects (2) A Level - Grade D in 2 relevant subjects (3) UEC - Grade B in 5 relevant subjects (4) Other IHL - Relevant Foundation/ Diploma accredited by MQA (5) TAR UC - Foundation in Arts (Track B) Compulsory subject: (1), (2), (3) and (4) must include SPM Credit/ O Level Grade C/ UEC Grade B in English Language AND (1), (2), (3), (4) and (5) must include MUET Band 4/IELTS Band Score 6.0/ equivalent Note: a) Students without a credit in SPM Bahasa Melayu are required to pass Bahasa Kebangsaan A before the award of Bachelor Degree. b) TAR UC Diploma will be accepted on credit transfer into Bachelor Degree programmes. c) Equivalent qualifications/qualifications from other Institution of Higher Learning (IHL) will be considered on a case-by-case basis. d) Subject to the Ministry of Education latest requirements.
